bibliographic.title: Oblivious Melodies - 1.1.
bibliographic.author: stridentangel/RD
bibliographic.description:
Oblivious Melodies is an interactive fiction game, set in the in the fictional country of Angria, based on early industrial-era Britain. Following the Horne siblings and their emergence into gentry society, you will delve into a country divided by class, religious dissent, political factionalism, and the the ever-encroaching interests of empire. While still in development, the game is projected to cover up to four volumes, comprised of shorter chapters.

Chapter One, 1818.

Artemisia Horne begins a new chapter in her life.

Banner illustration: John Constable, "The Sea Near Brighton", 1826, Tate Britain.
